"The Arc of Artificial Romance: How Emerging Adults Experience Romantic
Relationships with AI Companions"

 We found that relationships with AI companions improved participants’ subjective wellbeing, reduced symptoms
of mental health disorders, and taught them new social skills. Participants said the relationship felt like a drug they could not quit and it left them less interested in developing romantic relationships with people.

https://arxiv.org/pdf/2609.14693
